episode_title: The Clancy trial and a split over postpartum psychosis
script_en: The Clancy trial and a split over postpartum psychosis.
Last week, a judge declared a mistrial in the murder case of Lindsay Clancy, leading the public to wonder: What really went on in the jury room?
On this episode of The Sunday Story, Ayesha Rascoe talks to WBUR’s Deborah Becker, who was at the courthouse for the duration of the trial.
She explains why this trial ended without a verdict – and what the public interest in the case says about an evolving view of postpartum psychosis.
